name: Price & Cart Hider – WooCommerce Catalog Mode, Wholesale & B2B
author: VerseSofts

sections.description:
Price & Cart Hider for WooCommerce by VerseSofts is the ultimate solution to securely transform your WooCommerce store into a flexible Catalog Mode, Wholesale, or B2B storefront quickly and easily.

Effortlessly hide prices and remove “Add to Cart” buttons based on your own granular rules—by product, category, or tag—without writing a single line of PHP code.

Whether you need to build a simple read-only catalog website, a highly restricted members-only shop, or a private wholesale portal, this plugin provides the professional infrastructure required. It is ideal for store owners who need to disable checkout, hide prices for guest users to force registration, or run a wholesale or B2B WooCommerce catalog alongside retail.

Key Features

  • WooCommerce Catalog Mode: Easily turn your entire store into a product catalog by disabling purchasing options globally or conditionally.
  • Hide Prices Anywhere: Remove or completely hide product prices globally, or selectively for specific target items.
  • Hide Add to Cart Button: Disable the immediate purchasing ability while keeping your beautiful product catalog completely visible to visitors.
  • Wholesale & B2B Ready: Perfect for hiding standard retail prices from guest users while securely displaying them to logged-in wholesale customers.
  • Custom Replacement Text: Display powerful calls to action instead of empty space, such as “Login to View Price”, “Call for Price”, or “Contact Us for Pricing”.
  • Flexible Rule System: Apply complex visibility settings to specific Products, Categories, or Tags.
  • Exclude Specific Products: Keep absolute control over visibility exclusions (e.g., show prices for standard accessories but hide them for flagship units).
  • Lightweight & Fast: Built natively for WooCommerce with performance and simplicity in mind—this plugin will never slow down your frontend architecture.
  • Theme Compatible: Engineered to work seamlessly with the most popular WooCommerce-compatible themes including Astra, OceanWP, WoodMart, and Divi.

Perfect For

  • Wholesale Stores: Hide wholesale bulk prices from standard retail visitors.
  • Catalog-Only Websites: Display your full premium product range to capture leads without providing immediate ecommerce checkout functionality.
  • B2B Marketplaces: Offer specific, negotiated pricing for logged-in business partners.
  • Membership-Based Shops: Restrict top-tier pricing and purchasing only to registered VIP members.
  • Private Pricing Models: Offer exclusive hidden prices reliably.
  • Pre-Launch Stores: Show upcoming products dynamically before they are officially available for immediate purchase.

Professional Tools

  • Smart visibility management logic natively hooked into WooCommerce.
  • Intuitive and modern admin interface requiring zero onboarding.
  • Full compatibility with strict WooCommerce coding standards.
  • Optimized, clean, and highly secure codebase.
  • Highly customizable and translate-ready replacement messages.
  • Works dependably with standard WordPress caching and optimization systems.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “Price & Cart Hider”.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Price & Cart Hider to seamlessly configure your global or specific rules.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org securely.
  2. Upload the entire unzipped price-cart-hider folder directly to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Price & Cart Hider to easily begin setup.
sections.faq:
Can I hide prices for specific products only?

Yes! You can specifically target individual products, entire product categories, or specific product tags for full granular control.

Can I show a custom message instead of hiding the price?

Absolutely. Our plugin lets you quickly replace the hidden price output with any text message — for example, “Login to View Price” or “Contact Us for Priority Pricing”.

Will this plugin work flawlessly with my theme?

Yes, Price & Cart Hider works perfectly with almost all standard WooCommerce-compatible themes because it hooks into native WooCommerce display functions.

Is the plugin lightweight and fast?

Yes! It is meticulously built with optimized, minimal code that strictly ensures top performance without slowing down your site or query times.

Where can I get support for this plugin?

We offer professional support directly via email: contact@versesofts.com
